name: Thomas More University
academic_ranking: Private Catholic university founded in 1921. Approx. 2,350 total students (2,126 undergraduate) as of fall 2024. Organized into three colleges: Liberal Arts and Social Sciences, Business, and Natural and Health Sciences. Accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools (SACS).

As a private not-for-profit institution, institutional merit and need-based aid are typically available; verify current figures via College Navigator (NCES) or the school's financial aid office.
facilities_notes: Softball program competes under Thomas More Saints athletics (thomasmoresaints.com). Specific softball facility details (field/complex name) not confirmed from fetched pages.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II softball program in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC). Thomas More transitioned to NCAA Division II in recent years after a Division III history. Program-specific competitive record/reputation not detailed on fetched pages.
